blocks.text: Jiddat aur takhleeqi salahiyat tarraqi ko aage barhati hain: roayati soch se hat kar sochna, naye khayalat lana aur munfarid hal dhoondna. Yeh hissa batata hai ke in ka matlab kya hai, yeh kyun ahem hain aur Pakistan ki rozmarra zindagi mein kaise lagayein.

blocks.prompt: Jiddat aur takhleeqi salahiyat ka aapas mein kya rishta hai?
blocks.explanation: Takhleeqi salahiyat naye khayalat paida karti hai; jiddat khayalat ko naye ya behtar products, khidmat ya tareeqon mein badalti hai.

items: Takhleeq khayalat banati hai; jiddat unhein kaam mein lati hai.
